messages:
Ibrahim A: dropped a quick mock for the "undo" toast when approving diffs in the eval runner: https://figma.com/file/undo-toast. want accessibility + microcopy feedback. goal: let people quickly undo accidental approves without stealing focus. :undo: Clara M: nice. main concerns: toast discoverability for SR users, keyboard reachability, and avoiding focus jumps that break workflows. also keep the copy short: 'Diff 4 approved.' + 'Undo'. Jon P: also think about keyboard shortcut flow. we have Shift+A to approve a focused diff. after that, where does focus land? if it stays on the approve button, hitting Enter again could re-approve/confirm; that's dangerous. recommend leaving focus on the next logical interactive element and making the toast tabbable if someone wants to undo. Ibrahim A: current plan: toast appears bottom-left, accessible name includes the diff title/id, timeout 8s, role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true", not auto-focused. toast contains a visible 'Undo' button that is tabbable but not in the default focus trap. animation 140ms. example we can ship with the PR: ```html
Diff 4 approved.
// JS: remove toast after 8000ms or when Undo clicked ``` Clara M: good snippet. a few notes: 1) aria-live polite is right — assertive will steal SR users mid-compare. 2) make sure sr-only copy includes which diff was approved when titles are truncated visually. 3) when the toast appears, do NOT move focus to it; only tab should reach it. otherwise keyboard users lose context. Jon P: add a keyboard safety: if approve is triggered via Shift+A, the keypress should swallow subsequent Enter for that control for a short debounce window to avoid duplicates. also tab order: diff row controls -> next row or next logical control -> toast (tab) -> rest of page. Document this in test cases. Ibrahim A: copy nit: suggestions: 'Diff approved' vs 'Diff 4 approved' — including the index helps SR users, but if titles are unique prefer title. propose: use title when <= 60 chars, otherwise fallback to 'Diff #4 approved.' Clara M: acceptance criteria proposal: 1) toast uses role=status + aria-live=polite + aria-atomic=true. 2) toast not auto-focused. 3) Undo button is tabbable and has clear aria-label including diff id/title. 4) pressing Undo reverts state and triggers a polite announcement 'Approval undone for Diff X'. 5) keyboard debounce prevents duplicate approvals. 6) toast timeout configurable via feature flag (default 8s). 7) SR test matrix documented (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver desktop/mobile). Jon P: add unit/integration tests: DOM test for presence of aria attributes, keyboard test for tab reachability, E2E for undo behavior and announcement text. also add telemetry event for "undo_clicked" with diff id. accessibility-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: eval-undo-toast -> role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-atomic, tabbable-undo-button, no-auto-focus, debounce-approvals, sr-fallback-title. See /docs/accessibility/eval-undo-toast.md :white_check_mark: Ibrahim A: awesome. I'll update the prototype and open a small PR with the toast component + tests. follow-ups: @Clara M to write SR test steps; @Jon P to add debounce + telemetry; @accessibility-bot to add checklist entry. target: behind feature flag next sprint. :rocket:
